吃饱喝足，王野骑着自行车到了没人的地方，把物资全部收入空间，时间还早，百货商店走起，有了手表票必须赶紧安排上，这一天天的不知道几点是真的不习惯，王野都不知道多少次习惯性的看表了。

现在四九城，如果在百货商店还买不到东西，那也不用去别的地方了，在别的地方也找不到。进了商店，直奔手表柜台，看着柜台里品类不多的几款手表，王野也是郁闷了，大上海很经典的品牌。

王野买表不像现在人一样为了面子，王野知道现在有些手表的升值空间很大的，大上海绝不在王野的考虑范围之内。因为前世王野拿着捡破烂老头，也就是吴志强的一块大上海去卖，人家就给500块，还说因为品相好，品相不好的百八十一块儿。

王野在柜台里看见了他认识品牌-劳力士，不是因为他有过，而是因为在后世劳力士太有名了，但是具体型号就不认识了。

柜台里一位售货员以为王野是随便看看，并没有招呼他，王野也不气恼，习惯了现在售货员的态度，不止他这样，各行各业都一样。你还不能跟人家吵吵，真要是敢吵吵，会有一大帮人过来教你做人。现在团结就是力量，可不只是一句口号，那是真的团结。

王野客气的说：“大姐，麻烦您拿一下这块手表。”

售货员听见王野叫她大姐，那嘴都咧到耳根了。

“这孩子，我都这么大岁数了，叫啥大姐，叫姨。”说着给王野拿出了那块儿劳力士。

王野把表放在手腕上看了看：“姨，这是啥表，多少钱啊？”

售货员热情地说：“这是劳力士，我们叫它泡泡背。这表可不便宜，要四百三十块呢！而且还要票。小伙子你是买表呀，还是闲逛呀？”

王野拿出手表票晃了晃：“姨，我是真买表，这不有工作了，家里奖励了一块表。”

“呦，你爹真大方！”

王野逗着闷子说：“那是，我可是我爹的亲儿子！”

一句话把售货员逗乐了：“这孩子说话真逗，说的好像别人不是他爹的亲儿子似的。你真要这表，其实大上海也不错，才140，便宜多了。”

“不用，姨，我就要这个，您给开票吧！”

售货员开完票，让王野去另一个柜台交过钱，拿了手表迫不及待戴上，还前后反转着手臂欣赏了一下：“谢谢姨，我再去逛逛，您忙着！”

售货员笑笑点点头。

王野一圈转下来买了很多东西，油盐酱醋，糖盐茶酒，还把所有的布票棉花票用完了，棉花票是真不多，只有五斤，后世只够做一床被子，现在两床都有剩余。

现在棉花是妥妥的军用物资，管控很严。在鸽子市上连枪都有卖的，就是没有卖棉花的。不是没人想卖，是真的不够，家家户户都不够，不看看就是最高的几位首长，一件棉大衣都穿好些年呢！

看了看新买的手表，快四点了，王野出了百货大楼。骑上自行车一路回到轧钢厂，再快进工厂时，把后面的麻袋换成了装虎骨的。

进入门房，赵爷爷还在看那张报纸，王野调笑道：“赵爷爷，你这报纸有啥看的，都看了多少遍了！”

赵爷爷没好气的说：“你懂个屁！这是学习D的思想，要进步！让你拿的东西拿到了吗？”

王野打开麻袋：“赵爷爷，你看看品质咋样？”

赵爷爷拿出一块闻了味，又用指甲掐了一下说：“不错不错，成年虎。”

赵爷爷指着旁边的麻袋说：“这是你师父买回来的辅药，还有煎药的工具，一会儿下班让你爹帮忙一起背回去。”

王野问：“赵爷爷，这虎骨你和师父有用吗？要不要分给师父一部分？”

赵爷爷摇头：“没用的，我和你师父的身体是需要修复，虎骨是为了锻炼筋骨的，对我们不光无益反而有害。”

没一会儿就下班了，王野等到王铁柱和刘叔，跟赵爷爷一起往家走。快到胡同口时，看见何雨柱一行人，何雨柱快走两步，走到王野跟前说：“王野兄弟，中午咋没去食堂呀？我等了你一中午。”

王野这才想起，早上上班时说去三食堂找何雨柱的。

After eating and drinking, Wang Ye rode his bicycle to a deserted place and put all the supplies into the space. It was still early and he was walking to the department store. If he had a watch ticket, he had to arrange it quickly. He was really not used to not knowing what time it was every day. Wang Ye didn't know how many times he looked at his watch out of habit.

Now in Sijiucheng, if you can't buy something in a department store, you don't have to go anywhere else because you can't find it anywhere else.After entering the store, he went straight to the watch counter. Looking at the few watches in the counter, Wang Ye was also depressed. It is a very classic brand in Shanghai.

Wang Ye doesn't buy watches for the sake of face like people do nowadays. Wang Ye knows that some watches now have a lot of room for appreciation, and Shanghai is definitely not within Wang Ye's consideration.Because in his previous life, Wang Ye took a piece of Shanghai owned by an old rag picker, Wu Zhiqiang, to sell, and they gave him 500 yuan, and said that because it was in good condition, the bad condition would cost him 181 yuan.

Wang Ye saw at the counter that he recognized the brand - Rolex, not because he had one, but because Rolex was so famous in later generations, but he didn't recognize the specific model.

A salesperson at the counter thought Wang Ye was just looking at him casually and did not greet him. Wang Ye was not angry. He was used to the current attitude of salesmen. It was not just him, it was the same in all walks of life.You can't quarrel with others yet. If you really dare to quarrel, a large group of people will come over to teach you how to behave.Now unity is strength, it is not just a slogan, it is real unity.

Wang Ye said politely: "Sister, please take this watch."

When the saleswoman heard Wang Ye calling her eldest sister, she grinned from ear to ear.

"This child, I am so old, I call her eldest sister, aunt." He said and took out the Rolex for Wang Ye.

Wang Ye put the watch on his wrist and looked at it: "Auntie, what kind of watch is this and how much does it cost?"

The salesperson said enthusiastically: "This is a Rolex, we call it a bubble back. This watch is not cheap, it costs 430 yuan! And it also requires tickets. Young man, are you buying a watch, or are you just hanging out?"

Wang Ye took out the watch ticket and waved it: "Auntie, I really bought a watch. I don't have a job anymore. My family rewarded me with a watch."

"Hey, your dad is so generous!"

Wang Ye teased Menzi and said, "That's right, I am my father's biological son!"

One sentence made the salesperson laugh: "This kid talks so funny, as if others are not his father's biological sons. If you really want this watch, in fact, the Shanghai Grand is not bad, it is only 140, which is much cheaper."

"No, aunt, I want this, please give me the invoice!"

After the salesperson finished issuing the ticket, he asked Wang Ye to go to another counter to hand over the money. He took the watch and couldn't wait to put it on. He turned his arms back and forth to admire it: "Thank you, Auntie, I'll go shopping again, you're busy!"

The salesperson smiled and nodded.

Wang Ye went around and bought a lot of things, including oil, salt, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, salt, tea and wine. He also used up all the cloth and cotton coupons. The cotton coupons were really not much, only five kilograms, which would only be enough to make one quilt in future generations. Now there are leftovers for both beds.

Nowadays, cotton is a proper military material and is strictly controlled.There are even guns for sale in the pigeon market, but no cotton.It’s not that no one wants to sell it, but it’s really not enough. Every household doesn’t have enough. If you don’t look at it, even the top leaders have been wearing a single cotton coat for several years!

Looking at his newly bought watch, Wang Ye left the department store at almost four o'clock.I rode my bicycle all the way back to the steel rolling mill. When I quickly entered the factory, I replaced the sacks at the back with tiger bones.

Entering the concierge, Grandpa Zhao was still reading the newspaper. Wang Ye joked: "Grandpa Zhao, what do you think of this newspaper? You have read it so many times!"

Grandpa Zhao said angrily: "You know nothing! This is the idea of ​​learning D, make progress! Did you get what you were asked to get?"

Wang Ye opened the sack: "Grandpa Zhao, what do you think of the quality?"

Grandpa Zhao took out a piece, smelled it, pinched it with his nails and said, "Not bad, good, adult tiger."

Grandpa Zhao pointed to the sack next to him and said, "This is the auxiliary medicine your master bought, as well as the tools for decoction. I will ask your father to help me carry it back after get off work later."

Wang Ye asked: "Grandpa Zhao, can you and Master use this tiger bone? Do you want to share some of it with Master?"

Grandpa Zhao shook his head: "It's useless. Your master and I need to repair our bodies. Tiger bones are used to strengthen our muscles and bones. They are not only useless but harmful to us."

After getting off work soon, Wang Ye waited for Wang Tiezhu and Uncle Liu and walked home with Grandpa Zhao.When they were approaching the entrance of the alley, they saw He Yuzhu and his group. He Yuzhu walked quickly and walked up to Wang Ye and said, "Brother Wang Ye, why didn't you go to the canteen at noon? I've been waiting for you all afternoon."

Wang Ye then remembered that when he went to work in the morning, he said he would go to the third cafeteria to find He Yuzhu.
